page.title: Natural Disaster Survival Roblox Quiz: 15 Questions per Attempt
page.description_md: Can you make the right call when the warning hits? Take 15 random questions, with five from each difficulty tier, and see how well you know Natural Disaster Survival.
page.seo_description: A warning can change your plan fast in Roblox Natural Disaster Survival. Test what you know about hazards, maps and survival choices in 15 random questions.

easy.question: What must you do to earn a survival point from a disaster round?

options.text: Stay alive until the disaster round ends.
Reach the map before the disaster starts.
Stay alive until the disaster warning appears.
Return to the lobby before the disaster ends.

easy.question: What does Acid Rain damage when it strikes the island?

options.text: Exposed players, while struck structures stay intact.
Struck structures, while exposed players stay unharmed.
Exposed players and the structures it hits.
Neither players nor structures; it changes their appearance.

easy.question: What rolls down the spawned mountain during an Avalanche?

options.text: Large boulders of stone.
Large chunks of snow.
Large stacks of timber.
Large drums of metal.

easy.question: Which position leaves a player exposed to Blizzard health loss?

options.text: Inside a sheltered corner, surrounded by intact walls.
Beneath sheltered stairs, enclosed by large surfaces.
On a sheltered lower floor, surrounded by walls.
Out in the open, away from surrounding shelter.

easy.question: How can another player's Deadly Virus droplets infect you?

options.text: You touch one of the infected droplets.
You hear a cough without touching a droplet.
You see a droplet without touching one.
You enter the same building without touching a droplet.

easy.question: What can Earthquake shaking do to tall, unstable structures?

options.text: Raise the structures smoothly above the shaking ground.
Make the structures collapse onto the island.
Keep the structures fixed above the shaking ground.
Strengthen the structures as the surrounding ground shifts.

easy.question: How does a Fire begin spreading through a map?

options.text: All blocks ignite together, without flames spreading between parts.
A block ignites but the flames stay on that part.
A block ignites and the flames spread to other parts.
Players ignite first and transfer flames to the map's parts.

easy.question: What happens to the water level when a Flash Flood begins?

options.text: It gradually rises around the map.
It gradually falls away from the map.
It stays at its normal level throughout.
It drops below the island before flooding starts.

easy.question: What is the main moving-object danger during a Sandstorm?

options.text: Cracks in the ground opening across the map.
Explosions of sand erupting across the map.
Surges of floodwater sweeping across the map.
Fast-moving debris swept across the map.

easy.question: What can a direct Thunderstorm lightning strike do?

options.text: Hurt a player while leaving every struck part intact.
Kill a player and destroy the parts it hits.
Stun a player while leaving their health and struck parts unchanged.
Destroy struck parts while leaving a directly hit player unharmed.

easy.question: What happens to building parts caught by a Tornado?

options.text: They vanish intact without leaving any loose debris.
They stay attached and become too heavy to move.
They can break loose and be flung around.
They stay attached while the funnel passes through them.

easy.question: What moves across the island during a Tsunami?

options.text: A large tidal wave travels across it.
A whirlpool circles beneath its center.
A water column rises vertically from it.
A water level rises evenly around it.

easy.question: What does the volcano throw toward the island during Volcanic Eruption?

options.text: White and gray steam clouds.
Gray and brown stone boulders.
Blue and white water columns.
Red and yellow lava blocks.

easy.question: Why is stepping or jumping onto Earthquake debris dangerous?

options.text: The parts slow your movement without causing damage.
The parts cushion every landing without causing damage.
The parts can injure or fling your character.
The parts steady your position without causing damage.

easy.question: What route does a Tornado follow around the island?

options.text: The same fixed circuit on every round.
A random path that can change direction.
A path that always follows the nearest player.
A fixed line from the map's center to its edge.

medium.question: Which early sound timing can signal Acid Rain after you reach a map?

options.text: The wind soundtrack begins only after the round ends.
The wind soundtrack begins only after the warning appears.
The wind soundtrack begins only after the rain stops.
The wind soundtrack begins immediately after you arrive.

medium.question: A structure part turns green after Acid Rain hits it. What state is it in?

options.text: Detached from its structure and harmful to touch.
Attached to its structure and harmful only after turning black.
Attached to its structure and harmless to touch.
Detached from its structure and harmless to touch.

medium.question: The Avalanche mountain is already present when you arrive. When do its large snow chunks begin appearing?

options.text: After the disaster round has ended.
After the disaster warning is given.
As soon as the map first loads.
Before the mountain appears beside the island.

medium.question: Which Blizzard exposure stage first causes gradual health loss?

options.text: Stage 1.
No exposure stage.
Stage 3.
Stage 2.

medium.question: Sandstorm debris is flying from left to right. Where should you move to reduce the flying-object risk?

options.text: A roof on the right side, directly in the debris's path.
The left side of the map, with room from the edge.
The right side of the map, ahead of the debris.
The center of the map, directly in the debris's path.

medium.question: How can Flash Flood water weaken a building from below?

options.text: Submerged supports remain intact while only dry supports detach.
Submerged supports become heavier while every joint stays intact.
Submerged supports rise together while staying firmly joined.
Submerged supports can detach or be destroyed.

medium.question: During a Meteor Shower, which situation can kill you even if no meteor touches your character?

options.text: You stand on a plate that a meteor strikes.
You stand on untouched ground after a meteor disappears over the sea.
You stand beneath a meteor's shadow without any impact nearby.
You stand beside intact cover while meteors and debris pass clear of your position.

medium.question: Storm clouds can appear before a Tornado warning. Which other pair shares that early weather?

options.text: Thunderstorm and Fire.
Earthquake and Fire.
Flash Flood and Thunderstorm.
Flash Flood and Earthquake.

medium.question: Which color marks a Fire-burned plate that is safe to touch?

options.text: Black.
Red.
Yellow.
Orange.

medium.question: Which Launch Land control releases the bridge attached to the rocket?

options.text: The red button inside the rocket.
The yellow button atop the large tower.
The upper button on the second tower.
The lower button on the second tower.

hard.question: In a Fire plus Flash Flood or Tsunami round, what can active fire do when water reaches it?

options.text: Pause burning until the water moves away again.
Go out permanently as soon as water touches it.
Keep burning on parts that are underwater.
Burn only at the surface, leaving submerged parts unlit.

hard.question: In a Tornado plus Volcanic Eruption round, which statement about lava blocks is true?

options.text: They become fixed in place once the Tornado reaches them.
They are too heavy for the Tornado to lift from the ground.
They can only slide along the ground when the Tornado moves them.
The Tornado can pick up and carry them.

hard.question: During a standalone Earthquake on Modest Headquarters, how does the huge green grass patch behave?

options.text: It remains anchored and does not move with the shaking parts.
It sinks below the island when the nearby buildings shake.
It comes loose and is thrown around with the shaking parts.
It breaks apart when the nearby buildings begin to shake.

hard.question: Which water-tower route fits a Tsunami crossing Trailer Park?

options.text: Use the first ladder in the wave's path if available, climb just above the wave, then jump as its front reaches the ladder.
Use the first ladder in the wave's path if available, climb far above the wave, then jump off before it arrives.
Use the first ladder in the wave's path if available, climb just above the wave, then jump off immediately after it passes.
Use a ladder away from the wave's path, stay below its height, then jump off just after it passes.

hard.question: During Fire on Raving Raceway, which choice accounts for its grassy terrain?

options.text: Choose the highest grass; all lower grassy terrain can burn.
Choose the lowest grass; higher grassy terrain can burn.
Choose any grass; every grassy level is fireproof.
Avoid all grass; every grassy level burns equally.

hard.question: Apart from fixed map exceptions, how do anchored and unanchored parts differ during an Earthquake?

options.text: Anchored parts remain fixed; unanchored parts only shake with the island.
Anchored and unanchored parts shake equally; neither kind can be flung from the island.
Anchored parts can be flung violently; unanchored parts remain fixed on the island.
Anchored parts shake with the island; unanchored parts can be flung more violently.
